outcome: Fetal thymus size (anteroposterior diameter, transverse thymic diameter, thymic-thoracic ratio)
Maternal serum inflammation parameters (white blood cell count)
cohort: The study included 50 pregnant women aged 18-40 years with active amniotic fluid leakage between 24 and 37 gestational weeks as cases, and 60 healthy pregnant women as controls.
finding: In pregnancies complicated by PPROM, the fetal thymic-thoracic ratio and fetal transverse thymic diameter were significantly reduced compared to healthy controls, and there was a moderate negative correlation between maternal white blood cell count and fetal thymic-thoracic ratio in the PPROM group.
